# Language Guidance — Java

Reference: Google Java Style Guide — https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html

| id | Check | Default severity |
|----|-------|-------------------|
| CS-JV-01 | UpperCamelCase for classes, lowerCamelCase for methods/fields, CONSTANT_CASE for constants | Warning |
| CS-JV-02 | 2-space (or project-documented) indentation and column-limit conventions are followed consistently | Information |
| CS-JV-03 | No wildcard imports (`import java.util.*`) | Information |
| CS-JV-04 | Exceptions are not caught and silently ignored (`catch (Exception e) {}`) | Warning |
| CS-JV-05 | Javadoc present on public classes/methods | Information |
